payout_value_note: $50 to the referrer when the friend opens a qualifying checking account, plus another $50 when they open a loan — so $50 to $100 per referral per side. No limit on incentive dollars earned.
payout_quote: When you refer a friend or family member to open a new membership with a checking account1 or loan2, you could get $50.00 for each - up to $100.00 per referral! ... your friend or family member will get the same, too? Best of all, there is no limit to the number or referrals you can make!
steps: Member finds their unique referral code in Digital Banking (Details tab of Savings Account) and shares it with the friend.
Friend provides the referral code at account opening.

Checking leg: friend opens a required savings account ($1 min) plus a qualifying checking account, activates a Mastercard debit card, uses it 5 times within 60 days, and receives one $250+ payroll/government direct deposit within 60 days — both get $50.
Loan leg: friend opens a new Openland loan with a minimum balance of $5,000 (funded within 60 days; dealer financing excluded) — both get another $50.
Incentive deposited to both accounts once the friend meets the requirements.
catches: Per-referral range: $50 for a checking referral, up to $100 if the friend also takes a qualifying loan.
Checking leg requires 5 debit transactions + a $250+ payroll/government DD within 60 days.
Loan leg requires a $5,000+ new loan, funded within 60 days; dealer financing excluded.
No referrals to existing members; employees and family not eligible; 18+ to receive bonus.
Incentive reported on IRS Form 1099-INT; if the account closes within 6 months, the incentive is deducted at closing.
Offer subject to change at any time.
biggest_catch: No cap on earnings, but the friend must hit 5 debit transactions plus a $250 direct deposit within 60 days, and bonuses get clawed back if the account closes within 6 months.
eligibility: Openland CU membership; friend must be a new member (no referrals to existing members), 18+.
timing: Code sharing ~5 min active; incentive deposited once requirements are met.
